scheme_name: Maanki Munda Scholarship for Female Students
description:
The Maanki Munda Scholarship for Female Students is an initiative launched by the Government of Jharkhand in India.

This scholarship program was introduced in the year 2021.

It aims to promote higher education among female students in the state of Jharkhand.

The scholarship is named after Maanki Munda, a prominent tribal leader and freedom fighter.

The primary objective of the Maanki Munda Scholarship is to empower girls through education.

The scheme specifically targets female students from economically weaker sections of society.

The scholarship provides financial assistance to girls pursuing higher education.

Eligible courses include undergraduate and postgraduate programs.

The scholarship covers various fields of study including science, arts, commerce, and vocational courses.

The scholarship amount is set at INR 25,000 per year.

This financial support is intended to alleviate the burden of educational expenses.

The scheme aims to increase the enrollment of girls in higher education institutions.

The target is to increase female enrollment rates by at least 20% over the next five years.

To be eligible for the Maanki Munda Scholarship, applicants must meet certain criteria.

Applicants must be female students residing in Jharkhand.

They must have completed their secondary education from a recognized board.

The minimum percentage required in the qualifying examination is 60%.

The family income of the applicant should not exceed INR 2.5 lakh per annum.

This income limit is set to ensure that the scholarship reaches the intended beneficiaries.

Students must be enrolled in a recognized college or university for higher education.

The application process for the Maanki Munda Scholarship is straightforward.

Interested candidates must visit the official website of the Jharkhand government.

They need to fill out the online application form available on the portal.

The application form requires personal details such as name, age, and address.

Applicants must also provide details of their educational qualifications.

A crucial part of the application is the submission of income proof.

Documents such as the family income certificate are mandatory.

Additionally, students must upload their academic certificates.

A passport-sized photograph is also required for the application.

Once the form is completed, it must be submitted online.

After submission, applicants will receive an acknowledgment receipt.

This receipt is essential for tracking the application status.

The scholarship is disbursed annually.

The disbursement typically occurs at the beginning of the academic year.

Students can expect to receive the scholarship amount by August each year.

The scholarship funds are directly credited to the bank accounts of the beneficiaries.

This ensures transparency and timely disbursement of funds.

The implementing authority for the Maanki Munda Scholarship is the Department of Higher Education, Jharkhand.

The department is responsible for overseeing the application process and disbursement of funds.

For any queries, students can contact the department through their official helpline.

The helpline number is available on the official government website.

The scholarship aims to address the gender disparity in education.

As of 2023, the enrollment of female students in higher education in Jharkhand stands at approximately 35%.

The government aims to increase this percentage to 55% by 2026.

The Maanki Munda Scholarship is part of a broader initiative to promote women's education in India.

The scheme has received positive feedback from various stakeholders.

Educational institutions have reported an increase in female enrollment since the launch of the scholarship.

The government has allocated a budget of INR 50 crores for this scheme in the financial year 2022-2023.

This budget is aimed at supporting thousands of female students across the state.

The scholarship is expected to benefit around 20,000 girls annually.

The initiative aligns with the national goals of the Beti Bachao Beti Padhao scheme.

The Maanki Munda Scholarship is a significant step towards achieving gender equality in education.

The government encourages schools and colleges to promote awareness about the scholarship.

Workshops and seminars are organized to inform students about the benefits of the scheme.

The scholarship not only provides financial assistance but also aims to boost the confidence of female students.

By supporting their education, the government hopes to create a more educated workforce.

The long-term vision of the Maanki Munda Scholarship is to empower women in Jharkhand.

Empowered women are expected to contribute positively to society and the economy.

The scholarship is a vital tool in breaking the cycle of poverty among marginalized communities.

The initiative reflects the government's commitment to social justice and equality.

In conclusion, the Maanki Munda Scholarship for Female Students is a transformative program.

It provides essential financial support to female students in Jharkhand.

The scheme is designed to promote higher education and empower women.

With specific eligibility criteria and a straightforward application process, it aims to reach those in need.

The scholarship represents a significant investment in the future of girls in the state.

Through this initiative, the government seeks to create a more equitable educational landscape.
